curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: open with the limits of assistance tech, then which warnings and assists may run on test day, why conveniences sit out, and the owner-manual duty
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on the limits rule, the permitted and banned lists, the test-day contrasts and the manual duty
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what assistance tech may and may not do for you and on test day

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach that warnings are passive, then backup and blind-spot warnings, rear, sideview and surround cameras, and their four contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per warning and camera plus the passive-announcer and placement contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each warning or camera shows and what you must still do

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach detection alerts and radar gap alerts, curve warnings and clean sensors, crash warnings and their sweep, speed and lane-departure alerts, parking sensors and cross-traffic alerts, with their contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per warning type plus the five contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each warning type flags and what it never does for you

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach what assist systems share, then auto emergency braking, auto reverse braking, lane keeping and left-turn avoidance, with the three contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per assist plus the announce-versus-act, halt-versus-nudge and quit-versus-freeze contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each assist does, when it quits and what still belongs to the driver

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach adaptive cruise and auto parallel parking and the contrast between them
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on adaptive cruise, auto parking and their contrast
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each convenience feature does and still leaves to you
